title: How do you choose identity verification methods for each country? | Identity Infrastructure Explained
summary: Start from the data you need, then match methods in each country: what AMLR requires, what eIDs and EUDI Wallet return, and how to fill the gaps.
body_markdown:
Choosing identity verification methods for a country starts with the data set the business needs. First, establish which data the regulations and the compliance team require. Then check which methods available in that country return that data, and decide how to fill any gaps that no method covers.


In many European countries, several methods return a comparable data set, and users have their own habits about which one they use. Outside Europe, there is often a single route: a biometric check or a check against a government database.


*Written by Helena Suska (Head of Customer Success), Authologic.*
